seo.title: Harbor Line Mobile Detail | Car Detailing at Your Home in Tampa
seo.description: Mobile car detailing across Tampa Bay. We bring water and power to your driveway. Prices shown, book online in a minute.

hero.sub: A showroom clean car without leaving home. We bring our own water and power, show prices up front, and text when we're 15 minutes out.

servicesHeadline: Everything your car needs, at your door

services.name: Exterior wash and seal
services.desc: Hand wash, wheels, tires, trim and a 3-month sealant.

services.name: Interior reset
services.desc: Vacuum, steam, shampoo and leather care. Kid and pet messes welcome.

services.name: Paint correction
services.desc: Swirl and scratch removal so the paint looks deep again.

services.name: Ceramic coating
services.desc: Years of gloss and easy washing, with a written warranty.

services.name: Fleet and office days
services.desc: We set up in your lot and work through the whole team's cars.

services.name: Maintenance plans
services.desc: Every 2 or 4 weeks, same crew, priority booking.

pricing.headline: Flat prices. No surprises.
pricing.sub: Sedan prices shown. SUVs and trucks add $30. We confirm before we start.
pricing.fine: Members get the same crew and priority booking. Cancel anytime.

guarantee.title: Not happy? We come back and fix it free.
guarantee.body: If anything's missed, text us within 48 hours and we re-clean it at no charge. No arguments.

areas.headline: We come to you across Tampa Bay
areas.body: No travel fee inside our zone. Just outside it, a flat $15. We'll tell you before you book.

booking.headline: Get your price and a time
booking.body: Pick a package and we'll text you a confirmed time, usually within the hour.

faq.q: Do I need to provide water or power?
faq.a: No. Our van carries its own water and power, so we can work in driveways, office lots and most apartment complexes.

faq.q: How long does a detail take?
faq.a: Exterior takes about an hour, Inside + Out about three. We'll give you a window when we confirm.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: No. Leave the car unlocked or the keys somewhere safe and we'll text you when it's done.
We reschedule at no charge and text you the first open slot.
Card, Apple Pay or cash after the job is done. Nothing is charged up front.

final.headline: Your car, clean, this week.
final.sub: Pick a package and we'll text you a time.
